lines.text: If any pirates show up, I want them taken care of immediately.
No one has journeyed to Forbidden Island and returned to tell the tale,
but today two men who have devoted their lives to studying that infamous island...
Did you have to call so many reporters?
Can't have all the fun myself, can I?
The more the merrier, wouldn't you agree?
Just try not to make a fool of yourself or me.
Ladies and Gentlemen of the Press, thank you for your patience.
I would like to present to you a brief description of our planned expedition.
